findings.evidence: Reflection.lean:42 `variable {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]`; :90 `reflection_reflection_apply`, :109 `det_reflection` — both used by the new lemmas at Basic.lean:108 and :136. Mathlib `LinearAlgebra/Determinant.lean:272` states `det_eq_one_of_not_module_finite` over a general `R`, so the `Module.Finite` branch at Basic.lean:107-112 carries over unchanged. Mathlib has no reflection-swap lemma (grep of `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Reflection.lean` finds none), so `reflection_sub_apply_left` is genuinely new API that belongs with the rest.
findings.fix: Move all three into `Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/Reflection.lean` under `LinearMap.BilinForm` with the module's existing `variable {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]`: `det_reflection_comp_reflection` transfers verbatim (`det_comp`, `det_reflection`, `LinearMap.det_eq_one_of_not_module_finite`, all stated over a general ring/field), and `reflection_sub_apply_left` only needs the norm expansion inlined (`map_sub`, `hSymm.eq`, `ring`) in place of the ℝ-only `Kinematics.Bilin.apply_sub_self`. Call sites in `Spectators.lean:85,109,110,112` then use plain dot notation. No new module is needed and no import changes: `Tensors/Basic.lean:10` already has `public import EpsilonEridani.Mathematics.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Reflection`.
findings.issue: `Bilin.det_reflection_comp_reflection` (:105) and `Bilin.reflection_sub_apply_left`/`_right` (:116, :132) contain no DIS content — no `K`, no `pTransverse`, no kinematics — yet are stated only for `Bilin V = BilinForm ℝ V` in a new `DIS.Tensors.Bilin` namespace, while every input they use (`reflection_apply`, `reflection_apply_self`, `reflection_reflection_apply`, `det_reflection`) lives at `{K V} [Field K]` in `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/Reflection.lean`, namespace `LinearMap.BilinForm`. The result splits the reflection API across two namespaces and two generality levels.

summary: The decomposition theorems themselves sit at the right level (no symmetry on W, A only parity-odd and non-zero, injectivity on the weak `A e e' ≠ 0`, `hsign` instead of equal norms), and the earlier special-case duplications are gone. The three new reflection lemmas, however, are field-generic bilinear-form facts restated at ℝ inside a DIS module, below the level of the in-repo general reflection module that this very file already imports.
